facts.text: VLMBenchEnv is a gymnasium.Env: the class is declared as `class VLMBenchEnv(gym.Env)`
VLMBenchEnv takes a task class and an observation_mode of 'state' or 'vision'; any other mode raises ValueError
The wrapper builds an amsolver Environment with ArmActionMode.ABS_JOINT_VELOCITY, launches it headlessly and gets the task from it
The action space is Box(low=-1.0, high=1.0, shape=(Environment.action_size,))
The supported-robot table gives the panda 7 arm joints
Action_size is the arm action size plus one gripper value, and for ABS_JOINT_VELOCITY the arm action size is the supported arm's joint count
The state observation space is Box(-inf, inf, shape=obs.get_low_dim_data().shape)
Vision mode is a Dict of the state plus left_shoulder_rgb, right_shoulder_rgb, wrist_rgb and front_rgb images
VLMBenchEnv.reset calls task.reset() and returns the extracted observation with the descriptions list added
VLMBenchEnv.step calls task.step(action) and returns (observation, reward, terminate, {})
TaskEnvironment.step treats the last action value as the gripper command and the rest as the arm action
The arm action length must equal the number of arm joints
The gripper command is open above 0.5 and closed below 0.5; exactly 0.5 keeps the current state
TaskEnvironment.step returns float(success) as the reward and the task's terminate flag, with 1.0 when a success occurred along a path and 0.5 for a grasp success

Observation.get_low_dim_data concatenates gripper_open first, then the non-None joint velocities, joint positions, joint forces, gripper pose, gripper joint positions, gripper touch forces and task low-dimensional state
The scene fills joint velocities, joint positions, gripper_open (1.0 when the gripper opening is above 0.9), gripper_pose (the tip pose), gripper joint positions and the task state
amsolver.gym registers every task file under vlm/tasks as <task>-state-v0 and <task>-vision-v0 with entry point amsolver.gym:VLMBenchEnv
TASKS_PATH is ../../vlm/tasks relative to the amsolver/backend package, so the task classes are read from the clone tree
Environment.launch creates a PyRep and launches task_design.ttt headlessly
TaskEnvironment declares a module constant _DT = 0.05
The registration calls set no max_episode_steps, so a state environment has no truncation wrapper
The documented Gymnasium example makes drop_pen_color-vision-v0, the vision id of the same task
The AMSolver install instructions require CoppeliaSim 4.1.0 and PyRep

determinism.notes: the fake re-seeds its generator on reset(seed) and is deterministic after that; the upstream VLMBenchEnv.reset() takes no seed and its task placement uses numpy's random generator, so a seed is a bridge extension and was never compared with the upstream environment

gaps: no dynamics: the fake integrates joint positions with position += 0.05 s * target velocity; it models no contacts, friction, gravity, actuator, sensor or noise
the fake has no task scene, objects, language descriptions or success condition from the 32 task files under vlm/tasks: it stands in for the state-mode interface, not for a task

the upstream wrapper returns only the observation from reset() and a 4-tuple from step() (the legacy Gym API); the fake follows the Gymnasium reset 2-tuple and step 5-tuple that the bridge reads, accepts the bridge's seed and options, and ignores options because the upstream reset() takes no arguments

the fake's 29-element state is only the prefix of the real low-dimensional observation that the clone defines: gripper_open (1), joint velocities, joint positions and joint forces (7 each for the panda) and gripper pose (7); gripper joint positions, gripper touch forces and task_low_dim_state are omitted and the real length depends on the PyRep gripper and the task
vision mode returns 1x1 RGB placeholders; the real camera default is 128x128 (observation_config.py:14) and no rendering was run

the upstream simulation step is not stated in a text file: task_environment.py:27 declares _DT = 0.05 but no other line uses it, and the scene step is stored in the binary task_design.ttt; timestep_ms 50 describes the fake's own step
no snapshot or restore is offered: neither the wrapper nor the fake exposes get_state/set_state
the fake was never compared with the upstream environment: CoppeliaSim 4.1.0 and PyRep are required (README.md:20) and were not installed or run

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
